tasks.short: Prepare and coordinate health education grants

steps.what: Develop grant scope, evidence, commitments and budget assumptions
Prepare grant application narrative and supporting documents

loop.purpose: Draft application sections from supported programme facts
loop.input: Grant requirements, programme brief and checked budget assumptions
loop.output: Sectioned application draft with evidence links and missing requirements
loop.check: Specialist checks that objectives, beneficiaries, outcomes and commitments match supplied evidence; numbers must trace to the budget and unsupported promises are removed
loop.stop: One correction pass then manual writing for unresolved requirements
loop.why_not_simpler: Forms handle repeated fields, but narrative must connect variable programme evidence to funder questions

steps.what: Coordinate partner review and submit the checked grant application for authorisation

tasks.design: Use native grant forms and {DOCS} templates first, with a bounded loop drafting only narrative sections from the agreed brief. The specialist checks and coordinates the package; the programme director retains final funding commitments and external submission authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programme evidence must be rewritten against each funder's questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded text drafting can organise supplied facts without deciding programme commitments.
tasks.still_hard: Credible outcomes, partner agreement and funder-specific eligibility.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist judges what the programme can responsibly promise.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft prose, with partnership and budget responsibilities retained.

reach.task: Supply community need evidence for proposals
reach.learn: Evidence limits and programme outcome definitions

evidence.claim: A bounded drafting tool can organise supplied facts into grant sections, but the digest's case-note tools do not establish grant capability or savings. This design is E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary ends at coordinated internal application handoff. Director authorisation, external submission and partner labour are outside the focal denominator and retain existing effort.

Specialist produces funder questions, deadlines, eligibility notes, objectives, beneficiaries, evidence references, agreed commitments and checked cost lines in s1. Its full 45 hours include gathering and capturing inputs; missing commitments are clarified manually.
No model invents outcome evidence or budget values. Partner review remains in the unchanged coordination step.
Test native form reuse first. Four focal upkeep hours cover call changes and draft sampling; two additional director-review hours are other-role effort per 100 focal baseline hours.
research_questions: Do supported drafts save time after evidence capture, partner correction and authorisation preparation?

already_counted.description: Check narrative meaning and correct unsupported claims

incremental.description: Update call templates and sample draft quality

approvals.approved_version: Exact narrative, budget version, attachments and partner commitments handed to the director; changes void internal acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+15+30=90; gross 10 minus 4 upkeep gives net 6. Low 1 allows five extra narrative correction hours. Programme decisions and partner coordination retain time; E1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Guide agencies on health education programmes

steps.what: Assess agency needs and health education programme context
Provide guidance on assessment, development and delivery of health education

tasks.design: Retain agency assessment and tailored guidance with the specialist. Existing evidence in {DOCS} can support the discussion without adding an assumed report-writing baseline.
tasks.previous_blocker: Appropriate guidance depends on local context and agency capability.
tasks.enabler_now: Accessible evidence supports discussion but does not establish shorter advisory work.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling community needs with practical delivery constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist recognises context and negotiates feasible action.
tasks.altitude: Advice time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Check feasibility of proposed local programmes
reach.learn: Community access barriers and delivery constraints

evidence.claim: Tailored agency guidance relies on contextual judgement and discussion; generic document drafting does not establish a saving in this boundary.

assumptions: Boundary is assessment and advisory interaction, excluding separately commissioned written materials.
Specialist establishes needs in s1 during full-time discussion; no structured needs score or automated recommendation is assumed.
Check existing evidence access before considering tools.
Zero incremental upkeep because advisory work is unchanged; agency staff labour remains outside the focal denominator.
research_questions: Which advisory delays are document access rather than contextual assessment?

already_counted.description: Assess context and provide tailored advice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0. Context assessment and agency guidance remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Design training programmes for new and continuing employees
Administer course enrolment, session notices and completion records
Deliver training and assess employee understanding through practice

tasks.design: Configure recurring administration in {LMS} from the specialist's course brief and verified employee roster. Preserve learning design, direct delivery and competence assessment; automated notices do not certify understanding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine enrolment and notices require repeated handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native learning-system rules can reuse approved course and roster fields.
tasks.still_hard: Suitable learning objectives and assessing practical understanding.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist adapts instruction and recognises whether learning has occurred.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive administration with teaching and assessment retained.

evidence.claim: Native learning-system enrolment and notice rules can reduce repeated administration; learning design and teaching remain human. This is E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes course design, administration and direct delivery; employee learning time is not focal labour and remains unchanged.

Specialist produces course identifier, eligible roles, sessions, capacity, approved notice text and completion criteria in s1. HR supplies employee identifier, role, contact and active status from existing records; no additional HR capture is assumed.

s2 enrols and notifies before delivery, then records evidence after s3. It is the same administration activity across the course lifecycle; attendance evidence is produced only by s3 before completion entry, never consumed in advance.
s2's remaining 12 hours include roster verification, manual exceptions and attendance entry. No attendance sensor or automatic competence judgement is assumed.
Test native learning rules first. Three focal upkeep hours and two other-role roster-support hours are additional per 100 baseline hours.
research_questions: Do recurring enrolment rules save time after roster checks and completion evidence entry?

already_counted.description: Check eligibility and handle administration exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+12+40=92; gross 8 minus 3 upkeep gives net 5. Low 1 allows four extra roster correction hours. Teaching and design retain their full time; E1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop educational materials and agency programmes

steps.what: Develop programme objectives and educational content for community and government agencies
Draft educational materials and programme documents from the agreed design

loop.purpose: Draft agency education documents from agreed content
loop.input: Programme objectives, audience brief and approved source passages
loop.output: Draft materials and programme description with evidence links
loop.check: Specialist checks health meaning, audience fit, feasibility and consistency with agreed objectives; unsupported recommendations and invented outcomes are removed
loop.stop: One revision then manual drafting if content cannot be supported
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates organise sections, but varied audiences and programme descriptions need language interpretation

steps.what: Review materials and hand over the proposed programme package

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} templates with a bounded draft step after objectives and content are agreed. The specialist checks the package before agency handover; programme adoption and delivery authority stay with the agency.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agreed programme ideas must be rewritten for different agency audiences.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bounded drafting can organise existing content, without deciding programme suitability.
tasks.still_hard: Local feasibility, cultural fit and accurate health communication.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist links evidence to community needs and realistic delivery.
tasks.altitude: Less draft prose with programme design and final content judgement retained.

reach.task: Review local usability of agency materials

evidence.claim: Drafting from approved content can support agency education documents; the digest supplies no direct programme-development case, so capability and savings here are E1 design assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is agency-commissioned programme and material development. If the same publication also appears in the general materials task, assign it one owner rather than adding both savings.

Specialist produces objectives, audience, delivery constraints, approved claims, source/version references and agreed activities in s1. Its full 45 hours include consultation and evidence capture; missing facts are resolved manually.
No model invents public-health guidance or authorises agency programmes. Agency adoption and delivery effort remain outside the focal denominator.
Test native templates first. Four focal quality-review hours and two additional agency-review hours are ongoing per 100 focal baseline hours.
research_questions: Do supported drafts reduce composition after audience adaptation and agency corrections?

incremental.description: Sample quality and maintain source templates
Additional agency review of generated-content issues

approvals.approved_version: Exact proposed package, source versions, audience and objectives; changes void handover approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+18+25=88; gross 12 minus 4 upkeep gives net 8. Low 1 allows seven extra hours of audience and factual correction. Programme design and handover review retain time; E1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce draft prose and recurring course administration while retaining health judgement, agency advice and teaching.
reach: Work with community health workers on programme usability
role.ambitious_version: A specialist with clearer proposals and programme documents, while decision authority stays explicit.
